scope: 167-radius T-released cool closure results/nk167_hot (PTC on T, build 31, ultra-trace weight 1e-12 since iterate 25), written before any result it governs.

evidence_at_registration.front_T_K: 10.2-10.3 kK (peak 10335 K), rising 150-250 K per iterate
evidence_at_registration.GENCOOL_net_cooling_front: +0.4e-9 to +2.4e-9 erg/cm3/s, ~200% of total, dominated by H I collisional cooling: GENCOOL and the RE row disagree, so the front populations are not in statistical equilibrium

continue_while_any: front max T rises by >= 1% over the last 4 accepted iterates
front max RE net/gross falls by >= 10% over the last 4 accepted iterates
max significant Newton step falls by >= 2x over the last 4 accepted iterates
stop_rule.budget: until 2026-10-08 18:00 local (about 42 h after registration) or 80 more iterates, whichever first
stop_rule.on_stop_without_convergence: record 'numerical non-convergence at budget' (never a physical claim) with the front diagnostics; the physical existence question is then answered only by an explicit coupled existence test (front T pinned at several values, everything else Newton-converged, RE net read at the pinned depths), declared separately before it runs

not_changed: physics, products, convergence test (max significant Newton step < 1e-3 at PTC delta 0), audit thresholds
